faq.title: Questions? Answered.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: Is the Starter plan really free?
faq.a1: Yes. The Starter plan is free forever with 25 products and 50 orders per month. Pro and Business plans have monthly fees for more features.
faq.q2: How does the monthly subscription work?
faq.a2: Pay monthly based on your chosen plan: Starter (Free), Pro (Rs 3,900/month), or Business (Rs 9,900/month). Cancel anytime.
faq.a3: Bank transfer for online payments. Plus Cash on Delivery for buyers who prefer to pay in person.
faq.q4: When do I get my money?
faq.a4: Bank transfers are processed within 1-2 business days. COD payments you collect directly.
faq.q5: Do I need a business registration?
faq.a5: Nope. Just sign up and start selling. No BR needed for Free and Pro plans.
faq.q6: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a6: Yes — on the Business plan only. Starter and Pro plans use a Tap2Buy link (tap2buy.lk/yourstore).
faq.a7: All order data is encrypted and secure. We never see or store your bank account details.
faq.q8: How does Cash on Delivery work?
faq.a8: Customers can choose Cash on Delivery at checkout. They pay when they receive the product. Simple and trusted by Sri Lankan buyers.
faq.a9: Tap 'Create your store', add products, share your link. Done in under 60 seconds.
